referenceSources.title: Fiat 131 Abarth Gr.4 | invelt Rallied & Raced
referenceSources.description:
This Fiat 131 Abarth Group 4 rally car was prepared by Abarth for the Jolly Club and campaigned by Maurizio Verini in the Italian and European Rally Championships. Its yellow and gray livery features sponsor logos such as Olio Fiat, Pirelli, Ferodo, and Magneti Marelli, while the wide fender flares, rear spoiler, and racing wheels underscore its competition modifications.

Inside, the stripped cabin reveals a full roll cage and racing seats, emphasizing its purpose-built nature. The name “M. Verini” on the door pays homage to the driver who piloted this iconic Group 4 machine on gravel and tarmac stages across Europe.
